capabilities: Read selected text or entire notes aloud
Queue multiple notes for continuous playback
Generate and embed MP3 files in notes
Choose voices and adjust playback speed
extras: Relies on Microsoft's free Edge Read Aloud servers, which the README warns have been intermittently blocking the workaround since around December 17, 2025. A separate free companion mobile app (iOS/Android) can narrate notes shared from the OS and export MP3s back into Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to notes as spoken audio, which limits accessibility and multitasking use.

relations.evidence: read your notes aloud using Microsoft's Edge TTS API

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that reads notes or selected text aloud using Microsoft's free Edge TTS voices, with MP3 export and a playback queue.
